```{r}
library(tidyverse)

gss_url <- "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AU-datascience/data/main/intro_r_ecosystem/gss_extract_teach_clean/gss_extract_1972-2024_tidy.csv"

gss <- read_csv(gss_url)

glimpse(gss)
```

```{r}
gss_clean <- gss |>
  mutate(
    decade = (survey_year %/% 10) * 10,
    degree_level = factor(degree_level,
      levels = 0:4,
      labels = c("< high school", "high school", "junior college",
                 "bachelor's", "graduate")),
    teacher_allow_gay = as.factor(teacher_allow_gay),
      #levels = c("not allowed", "allowed")),
      teacher_allow_racist = as.factor(teacher_allow_racist),
     # levels = c("not allowed", "allowed")),
       teacher_allow_atheist = as.factor(teacher_allow_atheist),
     # levels = c("not allowed", "allowed"))
  ) #|>
 # drop_na(teacher_allow_gay, teacher_allow_atheist,  teacher_allow_racist)

summary(gss_clean)
```


```{r}
gss_clean |> 
  drop_na(degree_level, decade, teacher_allow_gay) |> 
ggplot( aes(x = decade, fill = teacher_allow_gay)) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill") +
  facet_wrap(~ degree_level, scales = "free") +
#  coord_flip() +
  labs(y = "Share of respondents", x = NULL,
       title = "Should a gay person be allowed to teach college?",
       subtitle = "By respondent's education level and decade")
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

teacher_long <- gss_clean |>
  select(
    degree_level, decade,
    teacher_allow_gay,
    teacher_allow_racist,
    teacher_allow_atheist
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(
    starts_with("teacher_allow_"),
    names_to = "group",
    values_to = "response"
  ) |>
  drop_na(degree_level, decade, response) |>
  mutate(
    allowed = response == "yes, allowed to teach",
    decade = factor(decade),
    degree_level = factor(degree_level)
  )
```

```{r}
gay_data <- teacher_long |>
  filter(group == "teacher_allow_gay")

gay_main <- glm(
  allowed ~ degree_level + decade,
  data = gay_data,
  family = binomial()
)

drop1(gay_main, test = "Chisq")
```

```{r}
gay_interaction <- glm(
  allowed ~ degree_level * decade,
  data = gay_data,
  family = binomial()
)

anova(gay_main, gay_interaction, test = "Chisq")
```

```{r}
library(emmeans)

emmeans(gay_interaction, ~ degree_level | decade, type = "response")
```

```{r}
support_by_group <- gss_clean |>
  select(
    decade,
    teacher_allow_gay,
    teacher_allow_atheist,
    teacher_allow_racist
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(
    starts_with("teacher_allow_"),
    names_to = "group",
    values_to = "response"
  ) |>
  drop_na(decade, response) |>
  mutate(
    group = recode(
      group,
      teacher_allow_gay = "Gay person",
      teacher_allow_atheist = "Atheist",
      teacher_allow_racist = "Racist"
    ),
    allowed = response == "yes, allowed to teach"
  ) |>
  group_by(decade, group) |>
  summarise(
    support = mean(allowed),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ggplot(
  support_by_group,
  aes(x = decade, y = support, colour = group)
) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_point(size = 2.8) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = scales::percent,
    limits = c(0, 1)
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(
      "Gay person" = "#009E73",
      "Atheist" = "#0072B2",
      "Racist" = "#D55E00"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Share saying the person should be allowed to teach",
    colour = NULL,
    title = "Support for allowing people to teach college has changed differently by group",
    subtitle = "General Social Survey respondents, by decade"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

```{r}
library(stringr)

teacher_vars <- c(
  "teacher_allow_gay",
  "teacher_allow_atheist",
  "teacher_allow_racist"
)

facet_n <- gss_clean |>
  mutate(respondent_row = row_number()) |>
  select(respondent_row, degree_level, all_of(teacher_vars)) |>
  filter(
    !is.na(degree_level),
    if_any(all_of(teacher_vars), ~ !is.na(.x))
  ) |>
  group_by(degree_level) |>
  summarise(n = n_distinct(respondent_row), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(
    facet_label = str_glue("{degree_level}\n(n = {scales::comma(n)})")
  )

facet_labels <- setNames(
  facet_n$facet_label,
  facet_n$degree_level
)
```


```{r}
ggplot(
  support_by_group_edu,
  aes(x = decade, y = support, colour = group, group = group)
) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ degree_level,
    ncol = 3,
    labeller = as_labeller(facet_labels)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = scales::percent,
    limits = c(0, 1)
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(
      "Gay person" = "#009E73",
      "Atheist" = "#0072B2",
      "Racist" = "#D55E00"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Share saying allow to teach",
    colour = NULL,
    title = "Support for allowing people to teach college",
    subtitle = "By target group, education level, and decade"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```
